title: SM-09.10 - Why EUSurvey deletes inactive surveys
intent: This article answers: SM-09.10 - Why EUSurvey deletes inactive surveys
short_answer: EUSurvey may automatically delete surveys that have been inactive for a long period to maintain service quality, optimize system performance, and support compliance with data protection and data retention requirements.
important_conditions: Deletion is preceded by several email notifications.
Survey owners and privileged users have time to review the survey and take action before deletion.
